mainEntity.name: What is the philosophy of Metamorphosis Centre for Change?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sayulita Wellness Retreat offers a personal and supportive environment that blends holistic healing with evidence based practices. The coastal setting naturally helps people feel calmer and more open, creating space for emotional clarity and physical restoration.

mainEntity.name: How safe is Ibogaine treatment at the retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ibogaine treatment is provided with medical supervision, thorough health screenings, and continuous monitoring. The team follows strict protocols to reduce risks and ensure guests feel guided and supported throughout the experience.

mainEntity.name: What types of programs are offered?

acceptedAnswer.text: The retreat offers a range of programs including 3 day and 7 day wellness retreats, couples retreats, private retreats, all inclusive group options, and specialized Ibogaine programs. Each one is designed to support healing, balance, and long term transformation.

mainEntity.name: Who is a good fit for the retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adults seeking emotional healing, addiction recovery support, trauma work, or personal transformation may be a good fit. Both individuals and couples attend. The environment is intentionally calm, inclusive, and supportive for people at different stages of their healing journey.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the cost of a retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Retreat costs typically include accommodations, meals, wellness therapies, guided activities, and personalized support. Ibogaine centered programs also include medical supervision, preparation, and integration after treatment. Pricing varies based on program length and retreat type.

centre.about_html:
A Place To Restore Your Mind & Body

There is something about arriving in Sayulita that feels quietly comforting. Maybe it is the way the ocean pulls your attention back to your breath, or the warm air that softens your shoulders almost instantly. At Sayulita Wellness Retreat, the goal is simple, although not always easy. Help you feel well again. Or well in a new way. People come here for different reasons, yet they often share a similar hope. A space to reset without judgment. A structure that supports healing without feeling clinical. And a retreat that understands how layered recovery can be.

Our programs are intentionally personal. Not overly strict, but grounded enough to give you direction. The team blends evidence based practices with a more holistic approach, which feels natural in this part of Mexico. You might notice the difference right away. The pace is slower, the conversations feel genuine, and the setting encourages a kind of openness that many guests say they have not experienced elsewhere.

Why Choose Sayulita Wellness Retreat

Choosing a Sayulita Wellness Retreat is not only about traveling somewhere beautiful, although the location is undeniably part of the experience. It is about finding a safe environment where support does not feel forced. Our specialists guide you through individualized plans that may include mindfulness practices, restorative therapies, light movement, nutritional guidance, and other integrative methods. Some days are structured. Others offer more space so you can process your own thoughts.

Perhaps that balance is what people appreciate most. It feels like a retreat, but also like real life, just a calmer version of it. And the community you meet here, even briefly, often becomes part of your longer healing story.

We also understand that many guests are looking for privacy. The setting and the layout of the property were designed to create quiet corners where you can step away without disconnecting completely. Whether you are here for emotional recovery, personal growth, or simply to regain clarity, the setting supports that intention.

What You Will Find Here

Thoughtfully Designed Programs

Every program is shaped to support long term wellness rather than quick fixes. These plans may involve holistic therapies, detox support, mindfulness sessions, and gentle lifestyle improvements that continue long after you return home. The approach is flexible enough to adjust as you change, which is often necessary. Healing is rarely linear.

A Setting That Encourages Healing

Located along the Pacific coastline, Sayulita feels grounding. The natural surroundings often help guests reconnect with themselves in ways they did not expect. It is subtle at first, then somehow very real. Our retreat uses the landscape to enhance your stay without overwhelming it.

Support That Continues

Recovery does not stop the moment you leave. We offer aftercare resources and guidance so you feel supported during your transition back into daily life. It is not a rigid process, just a thoughtful one.

raw_html:
A Place To Restore Your Mind & Body

There is something about arriving in Sayulita that feels quietly comforting. Maybe it is the way the ocean pulls your attention back to your breath, or the warm air that softens your shoulders almost instantly. At Sayulita Wellness Retreat, the goal is simple, although not always easy. Help you feel well again. Or well in a new way. People come here for different reasons, yet they often share a similar hope. A space to reset without judgment. A structure that supports healing without feeling clinical. And a retreat that understands how layered recovery can be.

Our programs are intentionally personal. Not overly strict, but grounded enough to give you direction. The team blends evidence based practices with a more holistic approach, which feels natural in this part of Mexico. You might notice the difference right away. The pace is slower, the conversations feel genuine, and the setting encourages a kind of openness that many guests say they have not experienced elsewhere.

Why Choose Sayulita Wellness Retreat

Choosing a Sayulita Wellness Retreat is not only about traveling somewhere beautiful, although the location is undeniably part of the experience. It is about finding a safe environment where support does not feel forced. Our specialists guide you through individualized plans that may include mindfulness practices, restorative therapies, light movement, nutritional guidance, and other integrative methods. Some days are structured. Others offer more space so you can process your own thoughts.

Perhaps that balance is what people appreciate most. It feels like a retreat, but also like real life, just a calmer version of it. And the community you meet here, even briefly, often becomes part of your longer healing story.

We also understand that many guests are looking for privacy. The setting and the layout of the property were designed to create quiet corners where you can step away without disconnecting completely. Whether you are here for emotional recovery, personal growth, or simply to regain clarity, the setting supports that intention.

What You Will Find Here

Thoughtfully Designed Programs

Every program is shaped to support long term wellness rather than quick fixes. These plans may involve holistic therapies, detox support, mindfulness sessions, and gentle lifestyle improvements that continue long after you return home. The approach is flexible enough to adjust as you change, which is often necessary. Healing is rarely linear.

A Setting That Encourages Healing

Located along the Pacific coastline, Sayulita feels grounding. The natural surroundings often help guests reconnect with themselves in ways they did not expect. It is subtle at first, then somehow very real. Our retreat uses the landscape to enhance your stay without overwhelming it.

Support That Continues

Recovery does not stop the moment you leave. We offer aftercare resources and guidance so you feel supported during your transition back into daily life. It is not a rigid process, just a thoughtful one.

  • Holistic non medicinal, wellness focused care for mind, body, and spirit
  • Wellness natural practices to restore balance and overall wellbeing

  • Group Therapy
  • 1 on 1 Counseling
  • Equine Therapy
  • Somatic Experiencing
  • Meditation and Mindfulness
  • Sound Therapy
  • Life Skills
  • Hypnotherapy
  • Massage Therapy

Conditions We Treat

  • Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
  • Anxiety
  • Depression
  • Stress
  • Trauma
  • Anger
  • Burnout

Substances We Treat

  • Nicotine
  • Alcohol
